description: Shared fixtures for the MCP output sanitizer. Canonical copy: SecID-Service test/fixtures/mcp-sanitize-fixtures.json; SecID-Server-API keeps a byte-identical copy at python/fixtures/mcp-sanitize-fixtures.json. Both implementations must turn each `input` into exactly `expected` (objects compared without regard to key order; a `text` field holding JSON is compared as parsed JSON). fn: response = sanitizeResponseForMcp / sanitize_response_for_mcp Inputs and expectations may use three macros, expanded by every runner before use: {"$repeat": [[piece, count], ...]} (a string), {"$list": [count, item]} (a list), {"$map": [prefix, count, value]} (an object with keys prefix0..). (service_message: true sets the serviceMessage option); record = sanitizeRecordForMcp / sanitize_record_for_mcp; listing = sanitizeListingForMcp / sanitize_listing_for_mcp; jsonrpc = sanitizeJsonRpcForMcp / sanitize_jsonrpc_for_mcp. `vocabularies` are the closed value sets and budgets both implementations must declare.
